summary: Forces the shape of the model's output. `json_schema` guarantees the response validates against your supplied JSON Schema.
combines: Supported on: `json_schema` (Structured Outputs) on gpt-4o and later, gpt-4.1, gpt-5 family, o-series; `json_object` is legacy and not recommended for gpt-4o and newer
`text.format.strict: true` restricts you to the Structured Outputs subset of JSON Schema (every property required, `additionalProperties: false`, no unsupported keywords) but gives a hard guarantee.
Prefer `json_schema` over `json_object`; `json_object` only guarantees syntactically valid JSON.
